question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"worldwide."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Worldwide"** means throughout the world, or on a global scale. (समूचे विश्‍व में, विश्‍वभर में, विश्‍वव्‍यापी) • **Example**: *The product will be marketed **worldwide**__.* • Grammatically, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it matches the context of the sentence. • The correct answer is **Option 1.** Correct passage: The Great Depression was a severe __worldwide__ economic depression in the decade ______ (2) ______ World War II. In most countries the depression ______ (3) ______ in about 1929 and lasted until the late 1930s or early 1940s. It was the longest, most widespread, and deepest depression of the 20th century. In the 21st century, the Great Depression is commonly used as an example of how far the world's economy can ______ (4) ______ .The depression originated in the U.S. Economic historians usually ______ (5) ______ the start of the Great Depression to the sudden devastating collapse of US stock market prices on 29 October 1929, known as Black Tuesday; some dispute this conclusion, and see the stock crash as a symptom, rather than a cause, of the Great Depression. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Statewide"** refers to something that is limited to a particular state within a country. (कुछ ऐसा जो किसी देश के किसी विशेष राज्य तक ही सीमित हो) • **"Nationwide"** refers to something that covers an entire nation or country. (राष्‍ट्रव्‍यापी) • **"Citywide" **refers to something that is limited to a particular city. (कुछ ऐसा जो किसी विशेष शहर तक ही सीमित है) 57:Tdf7, The correct answer is** "preceding."**
